desc:
🆕 UPDATE: 2 new maps (Timber Falls + Lost Temple), the AE86, NO BRAKES, ONE LIFE + LOW GRAVITY modes!

🏁 One car. Two players. Zero excuses when you miss the turn!

The DRIVER can't see the map. The NAVIGATOR holds the tablet and calls every turn: LEFT! RIGHT! SHARP LEFT! STOP! Use voice chat or quick callouts and race the clock across forest, mountain, canyon, logging valley and jungle temple stages.

But it's never that easy: mud splatters the windshield, doors fly open, the tablet gets knocked out of your hands… and yes, you can slap your partner when they mess up. 👋

🎮 MODES: Classic, Blindfold Run, I YELL, Championship, Swap Seats, Speed Run vs the #1 ghost, NO BRAKES, ONE LIFE and LOW GRAVITY

🎨 Paints, wraps, horns, helmets, emotes and more
🤖 No partner? Race solo with an AI co-driver

Works on PC, mobile, tablet and controller!

( TAGS: Rally, Racing, Cars, Co-op, 2 Player, Co-op Racing, Offroad Racing, Dirt Track )

Inspired By The Original Game Left Left Left!
